messages:
ashley: Kicking off EU4 observability bring-up for the new GPU pool. Need logs/metrics/traces, dashboards, and alert templates. Target SLAs: 200ms p95 for inference infra and <1% error rate on model-serving. Anyone free to pair on checklist?

devops-bot: Automation job queued: infra/boot/eu4/obs-stack -> started. Link: https://ci.redwood/internal/job/obs-eu4/42 :gear:

matt: I can take prometheus & alerting. Quick checklist from my side:
- Prometheus: scrape kubelet, node-exporter, gpu-exporter, cadvisor
- Alertmanager routing: route by severity & region -> page on P1
- Grafana provisioning: dashboard provisioning via /etc/grafana/provisioning/dashboards
- Tempo: collect traces from model-server sidecar and frontend

matt: Prometheus scrape snippet (add to prometheus-k8s config):
```yaml
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: 'gpu-exporter'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['gpu-exporter.eu4.svc.cluster.local:9100']
    metrics_path: /metrics
    relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_node_label_region]
        action: replace
        regex: (.+)
        target_label: region
```

li: I'll own logs (Loki) and agent config. Plan:
- Deploy promtail on GPU node pool with labels {cluster:eu4-gpu1, region:eu4}
- Add GPU-specific parsers for containerd logs (model-server stdout/stderr)
- Ship structured json to Loki with fields: model, shard, gpu_id, kv_cache_hit

li: promtail pipeline example:
```yaml
server:
  http_listen_port: 9080
positions:
  filename: /var/log/positions.yaml
clients:
  - url: http://loki-eu4:3100/loki/api/v1/push
pipeline_stages:
  - regex:
      expression: '^(?P<ts>[^ ]+) (?P<lvl>[^ ]+) (?P<msg>.*)'
  - labels:
      cluster: eu4-gpu1
      app: model-server
```

santiago: Networking note: EU4 peering uses MTU 1460. Large log batches were truncating in test -> set batch_size=256KB and reduce max_line_size. Also ensure NAT gateway has egress to S3 endpoints for long-term logs (prefix: s3.eu4.amazonaws.com).

matt: Alerts I want in the initial set (prometheus rules):
- GPU_Memory_Utilization > 90% for 5m -> severity: P1 -> page oncall
- model_server_request_latency_p95 > 500ms for 5m -> severity: P2 -> slack alert first
- node_disk_pressure -> immediate P1
- promtail_error_rate > 1% -> severity: P2

matt: Alert rule example:
```yaml
groups:
- name: gpu.rules
  rules:
  - alert: GPUHighMemoryUsage
    expr: avg by (instance) (gpu_memory_used_bytes / gpu_memory_total_bytes * 100) > 90
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: critical
    annotations:
      summary: "GPU memory >90% on {{ $labels.instance }}"
```

ashley: Grafana dashboards: need panels for KV cache hit rate, per-model latency, queue depth, gpu_utilization by pod, and cluster provisioning metrics (pending pods by node). Prefer JSON dashboards provisioned so infra can roll them.

li: Added dashboard provisioning files to infra/grafana/provisioning in a draft PR (#1234). Dashboards include GPU Overview, Model Server Latency, KV Cache Stats. PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/1234 :thumbsup:

santiago: Also confirm IAM roles for promtail/loki -> service account must have s3:PutObject for retention bucket. Mentioned in the onboarding doc.

ashley: Great. Next: validation steps before handover to oncall/team:
- Smoke: verify Prometheus scrapes all exporter targets (kubelet,node,gpu)
- Logs: query Loki for last 5 min per-model logs, check structured fields
- Traces: verify a sample trace from inference request flows to Tempo
- Dashboards: all panels return datapoints (no empty queries)
- Alerts: fire test alerts for GPUHighMemoryUsage and ensure they route to oncall after 3m

matt: I'll run the smoke commands and paste results. Example quick check commands:
```bash
# Check prometheus targets
curl -sS http://prometheus-k8s:9090/api/v1/targets | jq '.data.activeTargets[].labels'
# Query Loki for recent logs
curl -G "http://loki-eu4:3100/loki/api/v1/query_range" --data-urlencode 'query={app="model-server",cluster="eu4-gpu1"}' --data-urlencode 'limit=100'
```

devops-bot: Smoke pipeline completed stage: prometheus-scrape-check -> 200 OK. loki-ingest-check -> partial (some lines truncated, see santiago note). Tempo-check -> OK.

li: Adjusted promtail batching config to batch_size=256KB and max_chunk_age 1m, re-deployed. Will re-run ingest tests in 5m.

oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation for EU4 infra starts 2026-06-01. P1 paging after 3m. Slack paging channel: #oncall-eu4.

ashley: After li's re-deploy, can someone run the validation checklist and confirm here? I'll coordinate handover doc once validated.

matt: Confirmed Prometheus scraping all GPU exporters. Example target list shows gpu-exporter.eu4:9100, node-exporter.eu4:9100, kubelet stats ready.

li: Loki ingestion looks healthy now, structured fields present (model, shard, gpu_id). Query example returned >200 logs in last 5m.

santiago: Networking confirmed, NAT rules updated for S3 and egress checks passed.

ashley: Awesome. I'll draft the handover runbook and link it here when ready. Thanks all — planning to hand over to oncall tomorrow after one last smoke run. :rocket:
